summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing of VIEARTA Lifestyle expansion. Backend: 41/41 pytest cases passed — 12 prior iteration_1 tests (auth, checkins, recs, events, learning, rotating-message, 401) still green + 29 new lifestyle tests covering foods (library+custom+privacy), meals (totals math, filter-by-date, duplicate, copy-yesterday, delete), saved meals CRUD, hydration sum reflected in nutrition/today, targets defaults + PUT + unsafe rejection (422), estimator safety refusals (age<18, pregnancy, eating_disorder, chronic_condition) and valid estimate + disclaimer, nutrition/today shape, reflection upsert, 63 affirmations with 12 themes + theme/q filters, /affirmations/today rotation w/ favorited flag, favorite toggle + reflection, Jaylen seeded favorites (af_002, af_013 with reflections), 10 mindfulness activities with steps/purpose/duration + completion, 17 movement activities + rule-based pick /movement/today (personalized=true for Jaylen) + completion, routines CRUD, 7-day /summary series with all macro keys and mindfulness_sessions>=3 / movement_minutes>=20 / affirmations_saved>=2, cross-user privacy on meals + custom foods, JWT 401 on all endpoints. Frontend: Playwright validated login as Jaylen, Home Daily Affirmation card renders (data-testid=daily-affirmation) with 124-char text + fav & more buttons; sidebar Lifestyle nav navigates to /lifestyle with 3 gateway cards; /lifestyle/nutrition renders 6 progress bars (kcal/water/protein/carbs/fat/fiber) and water quick-log +250 ml increments visible total (800→1050 ml); meal logger opens, food search 'oat' filters, adding oats yields Total: 152 kcal, save + copy-yesterday buttons work; /lifestyle/mindfulness renders both tab-affirmations & tab-activities + aff-search; /lifestyle/movement shows mv-start-today + quick-log buttons; /progress renders progress-page with mindfulness/movement content; /lifestyle/nutrition/targets renders t-save + estimator (age=16 returns 'For students under 18, we recommend meeting with a qualified nutrition professional' block message); logged-out /lifestyle/nutrition redirects to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: lifestyle.py is ~910 lines — starting to get large; splitting nutrition/mindfulness/movement into three routers would help long-term maintainability.
Estimator endpoint accepts a raw dict (no Pydantic model) — safe here due to explicit int()/bool coercion, but a NutritionEstimateIn model would give validation + docs.
Saved meals POST accepts a raw dict payload too — consider a Pydantic model with items schema for parity with MealIn.
Seed clears then reinserts lifestyle collections for the demo user on every startup — fine for demo, would want a guard flag before prod.
MealIn.date is a plain string with no format validation; a stricter YYYY-MM-DD validator would prevent silent drift.
No pagination on /affirmations (returns all 63) — OK at this size, but should be paginated when catalog grows.
CORS allow_credentials=False with allow_origins='*' — fine for token-in-header auth, tighten origins before production.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All lifestyle collections use prefix 'viearta_'. JWT in localStorage under 'viearta_token'. Second-user register in tests must use a valid email domain (pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.demo/.example). Backend /api/lifestyle/* is wired via app.include_router(build_lifestyle_router(db, get_current_user)). Estimator has no Pydantic model — accepts arbitrary dict.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Initial test suite hit 8 setup errors because pydantic EmailStr rejects '@viearta.test' as a reserved TLD; fixed by switching to '@example.com' in the fixture, after which all 41 tests passed.
